title: Mitigating Automation Bias Through Cognitive Forcing Functions in High-Stakes Decision Environments
abstract_excerpt: We evaluate cognitive forcing functions across 420 participants in simulated diagnostic triage. Forced deliberation significantly reduced automation bias without increasing total task duration.

title: Cross-Cultural Measurement Invariance of AI Literacy and Discernment in the Global South
abstract_excerpt: Investigating cognitive offloading and AI literacy across representative urban and rural samples in Kenya and India (N = 750). Confirms that heuristic reliance varies systematically with digital infrastructure access.
